title.text: Questions on national income, answered from a governed source

subtitle.text: This is a demonstration version of Governed RAG: the user asks a question, the passages are chosen and the figures supplied using code, and a language model's output is used only for a short, checked explanation.

size_line.text: {passages} passages from {sources} sources · {economies} economies · {questions} questions in the bank · one user · a 4-billion-parameter language model on a laptop

use_mode_note.text: Passages are kept or withheld by the licence filter according to the use mode.

role_note.text: A short reply shows the figures and their data quality rating (DQR); a full reply also shows the definitions, the explanation and the trace.

bank_note.text: Bank questions were answered offline; this is the stored reply.

typed_note.text: For a typed question, the figures are supplied in this page using code, with no explanation.

walkthrough_intro.text: The walkthrough shows how Governed RAG works. You can follow one request, step by step, from the question to the checked reply. The language model's step comes between two layers of code and data built for this subject: the language model is sandwiched.

sandwich.text: Code before the language model: filters, routing, parameters, retrieval, figures, template part. Code after it: checks, record, token count.

coverage_intro.text: Each measure for each economy in the latest edition: exact, proxy or no figure.

reply_wording.NO_DQR: No DQR: this reply quotes passages only.
reply_wording.NO_PASSAGES: No passage in this use mode answers this question.
reply_wording.SERIES_HEADING: Series title (copied from the World Bank's list of series)
reply_wording.CLARIFY_LINE: This question is too vague to answer from the data. Pick one of these sharper questions:
reply_wording.NOT_BUILT: This question needs several steps planned in turn (route R6). That route is not built in this demonstrator.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_NOT_BUILT: Demonstrator note: a product would plan the steps itself, within a limit on steps, and show each one.
reply_wording.COMPARISON_LINE: People compare national accounts across economies to benchmark how each is doing. Check which measure is used and whether it is good enough for an international comparison.
reply_wording.EXPLANATION_HEADING: Explanation (written by a language model and checked against the figures above)
reply_wording.WITHHELD: The written explanation came from a language model and did not pass our quality checks, so it is not shown. Please contact our analyst if you want to know more.
reply_wording.DEMONSTRATOR_WITHHELD: Demonstrator note: this is a demonstration, not a product. A product would let you ask for the explanation to be refined, and would send your question to a named analyst. Here, no analyst receives it.
reply_wording.CORRECTED_HEADING: Corrected by the vertical domain expert
